verdict.reasoning: The printed page (VI-94) shows '6.18 THE INSPECT STATEMENT', '6.18.1 Function' and '6.18.2 General Format' in the same heading style as sibling statements. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md they are '### 6.18' (line 13441), '#### 6.18.1' (13443) and '#### 6.18.2' (13447), while 6.16 and 6.17 and 6.19 are '##' with '###' subclauses, and 6.18.4 (13552) and 6.18.5 (13720) are '###'.
